title: docs(skills): the grid 2xl paragraph names objectui's own BreakpointColumnMap and reads all six keys
body:
Fixes #7599

Clause-②: no — prose in the published skills catalog; no declared surface moves

## What changed

One paragraph in `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md`: the one under "Rule: Layout Responsiveness" that opens with a bold `2xl` sentence. Nothing else changed. It went from 7 lines to 5.

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| owner of the six keys | "The spec's `BreakpointColumnMapSchema`" | objectui's own `BreakpointColumnMap`, in `@object-ui/layout` |
| what `grid` reads | "only the first five" | all six |
| `{xs:1, "2xl":6}` | `grid grid-cols-1 gap-4` | `grid grid-cols-1 2xl:grid-cols-6 gap-4` |
| `{xs:1, xl:5}` | `grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-5 gap-4` | unchanged |
| advice | "Stop at `xl`, or carry the widest step in `className`" | removed, because it no longer applies |

## Why the behaviour half changed too

The triage (comment 5818990275) and boundary 1 in comment 5549222679 said to keep "`2xl` is accepted and then dropped" and change only the attribution, after re-measuring on main. I re-measured on base `1e946c96a`, and that sentence is no longer true. After this card was filed, objectui#7097 (PR #8435) added a sixth read arm and the `GRID_COLS_2XL` class map to `grid.tsx`. Its pin, `grid-breakpoint-columns-7097.test.tsx`, passes on base (11/11). The pin covers both rows the paragraph quotes: `{ xs: 1, '2xl': 6 }` gives `grid grid-cols-1 2xl:grid-cols-6 gap-4`, and `{ xs: 1, xl: 5 }` gives `grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-5 gap-4`.

If only the attribution were corrected, the paragraph would still tell authors to avoid a key that works. The claim comment allowed for this: the behaviour sentence was to be "kept only if re-measured true on main". Dispatch H2 says the same: if a behaviour sentence is false, correct it and say so.

## Measurements

- **H1: which package owns `BreakpointColumnMap`.**
  - On main, `export interface BreakpointColumnMap` is declared in `packages/layout/src/ResponsiveGrid.tsx`. `@object-ui/layout`'s index publishes it through `export * from './ResponsiveGrid'`.
  - `@object-ui/types` does not export it. Export lines under `packages/types/src` that name it: 0. Control: 3 export lines name `BreakpointName`.
  - The published 17.6.0 tarballs name the same owner. `@object-ui/layout`'s d.ts carries the type, at that version as a re-export from `@objectstack/spec/ui`. `@object-ui/types`'s d.ts files name it 0 times. Control: 7 of its d.ts files name `GridSchema`.
  - So the "(`@object-ui/types`)" in the triage comment is right for `BreakpointName` but not for `BreakpointColumnMap`.
- **Installed spec.** `@objectstack/spec` is 17.4.0. Its dist has 0 files that contain `BreakpointColumnMapSchema`. Control: 56 files contain `FieldSchema`.
- **H2: what the `grid` registration declares.**
  - `inputs` declares `columns` as `type: 'number'`, described as "Number of columns on mobile devices". It also declares the flat `smColumns` to `xlColumns` inputs. There is no flat `2xl` input.
  - The breakpoint-object form is declared by `GridSchema.columns` in `@object-ui/types`, which is now `number | Partial` of a `Record` over `BreakpointName` with number values. Its zod mirror is a `z.partialRecord` over the six names.
- **H3: the new sentence.** It follows the triage ruling and names `BreakpointColumnMap` in `@object-ui/layout`. It does not name the retired schema anywhere. `grid` does not import `BreakpointColumnMap`: its `columns` is keyed by `BreakpointName`, which has the same six names. The sentence claims only that the six keys are objectui's own vocabulary, declared as `BreakpointColumnMap`.
- **H4: gates.** Listed below.

It ran under the verify lock, whose verdict line was "command-exit 0".
- **No package was touched,** so no build, type-check or package test is owed.
- **Skill Example Check was not run locally. This narrowing is declared on purpose.** The gate needs a 30-package build first, with 28 turbo cache misses on a shared 4-core box. The evidence that its verdict cannot change:
  - The diff hunk contains 0 fence-delimiter lines and 0 HTML-comment lines.
  - `protocol.md` has 13 fences on base and 13 on head. A sha256 over every fence body, plus the line directly above each fence, is `38e8cf0aa790dff6` on both. As a control, editing one fence changes the hash to `4d017f0b19a3a643`.
  - The marker spelling occurs 88 times under `skills/` on both base and head.
  - No package source changed, so no built type changes.

## Skills catalog readings

- `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md`: 361 lines before, 359 after (15992 bytes before, 15881 after).
- All published `SKILL.md` files together (there is 1): 137 lines before, 137 after.
- objectui has no line ratchet on `skills/**`. The net change is -2 lines, and nothing was expanded.

## Acceptance notes

- The opening paragraph of the same section still says the object form is keyed by `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg` and `xl`. `2xl` is now named in the paragraph right after it. I left that list alone for two reasons: the file surface was this one paragraph, and a list that is incomplete is not wrong.
- The docblock of `grid-breakpoint-columns-7097.test.tsx` calls the drop that existed before objectui#7097 "the declared-but-not-read shape `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` warns authors about". That describes the history of the bug, and `protocol.md` still warns about the `cols` shape and the `props` shape. No edit, because `packages/` is out of scope.
- **Release timing.** Both objectui#7580 (the re-home) and objectui#7097 (`grid` renders `2xl`) are on main, and their changesets are still pending. The latest published version is 17.6.0, and there `grid` still drops `2xl`. The skills catalog is installed from this repository's main branch, and the next release ships both changes, so the paragraph describes the code it will ship with.
- `responsive-grid` is not touched.

## Merge safety

`origin/main` `c61099087` was fetched into a private ref. `git merge-tree --write-tree` against it exited 0. Since base, main has not changed `protocol.md`, `grid.tsx` or `ResponsiveGrid.tsx`.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么**:对外发布的技能包 `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` 里讲 `grid` 断点列数的那一段,原来 7 行,换成 5 行。其它内容都没动。
- **为什么改**:这段话在 main 上有两处已经不对。
  - 第一,它说六个断点键归 spec 的 `BreakpointColumnMapSchema` 所有。这个 schema 已经被 spec 退役,本仓装的 17.4.0 里已经没有它;objectui 在 `@object-ui/layout` 里自己重新声明了 `BreakpointColumnMap`。
  - 第二,它说 `grid` 会静默丢掉 `2xl`,并建议作者「停在 `xl`」。可是 objectui#7097 已经让 `grid` 正确渲染 `2xl` 了。
  - 不改的话,读这个技能包的 AI 会被教着回避一个其实能用的键,还会去找一个已经不存在的 spec 符号。
- **风险与代价(含回滚)**:
  - 这是纯文档改动:不动代码,不发包,不需要 changeset。
  - 唯一的风险在时间差上:npm 上最新的 17.6.0 里,`grid` 仍然会丢掉 `2xl`,修复要等下一次发版随 objectui#7097 一起发出去。技能包是从 main 安装的,所以它描述的是 main 上的行为。
  - 回滚办法:revert 这一个 commit。
- **席位意见**:
- **你要做的**:审阅这 5 行。同意的话,请留一条 APPROVED review:这是受管面 `skills/**`,需要 `os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong` 批准,之后由席位落地。
